data.description:
## Observation
In `sweep (windows)` diag run 44590213544 (throwaway branch `w1-diag-opcert-acl`, the plump-smelly-indianabat fix applied), `tests/unit/test_opcert_service.py::test_completion_pass_spawn_ceiling` (32 git processes, ceiling 30) and `test_completion_fail_spawn_ceiling` (20 processes, ceiling 18) fail. Diffing the job's spawned argv against macOS shows exactly 3 extra steps on Windows. The first is `git show tickets:.bridge_state\projects.json` where macOS runs `git show tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json`. The other two follow from it: `git add .bridge_state\projects.json` and `git commit -q --no-verify -m "chore: seed .bridge_state/projects.json ..."`. (macOS also runs one `ssh -V` that Windows does not.)

## Cause
`src/rebar/_store/project_ensures.py:34` builds `_PROJECTS_REL_PATH = os.path.join(".bridge_state", "projects.json")`. Line 67 uses it in a git revision path, `tickets:{_PROJECTS_REL_PATH}`. Git tree paths always use `/`, so on Windows the lookup never finds the committed file. `seed_projects_mapping_unit` then rewrites the file and runs `git add` + `git commit` on every ensure sweep. The commit has nothing new to record, so its failure is ignored.

## Approach
Make `_PROJECTS_REL_PATH` the literal `".bridge_state/projects.json"`. Git accepts `/` in pathspecs on Windows for `git add`, so the same constant serves both calls. The filesystem path on line 76 keeps `os.path.join`. No config key, env var or flag. Portable: the change removes a platform-dependent separator from a git object path.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/_store/project_ensures.py` — the constant.
- the existing project-ensure unit tests, plus a new test (file chosen beside the existing project_ensures tests).

## Testing
- New test (all platforms): `_PROJECTS_REL_PATH` contains no `os.sep` other than `/`. A second sweep of `seed_projects_mapping_unit` on a seeded tracker returns `ok` and runs only the `git show`, with no add or commit. The test monkeypatches `os.path.join` to join with `\\` to reproduce the Windows separator on POSIX, imports the module fresh, and runs the seed twice.
- After merge: the two spawn-ceiling tests pass in a `sweep (windows)` run.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] On a tracker where `.bridge_state/projects.json` is already committed, `seed_projects_mapping_unit` returns `ok` without writing or committing, on every platform, proven by a test that reproduces the Windows separator.
- [ ] `test_completion_pass_spawn_ceiling` and `test_completion_fail_spawn_ceiling` pass in a `sweep (windows)` run on main.
data.title: Windows: projects.json seed looks up tickets:.bridge_state\projects.json, misses it, and rewrites it on every sweep
